name: Oblivio: Lost In The World
source:
You try to find an answer why you are in an strange location that resembles a school and your purpose of being there.

After a brief wander, at the end of a corridor, you encounter a girl curled up by a door, you can tell that her style is far from ordinary. Perhaps she knows more than you do… Or maybe she’s the reason you’re here. Will she help you? Or maybe you will help her?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4109060/]Steam[/url]]
